exceptions.owner: Speak repository security and release owner
exceptions.technicalBlocker: The latest official qwen-tts release, 0.1.1, requires transformers==4.57.3. The patched Transformers 5.x line is not API-compatible with the current Qwen runtime.
exceptions.exploitabilityAssessment: The vulnerable Trainer checkpoint-loading path is not imported or used by Speak's Qwen inference workers.
compensatingControls: Qwen runs offline with local model directories only.
Model validation rejects executable, pickle-based, symlinked, custom-code, auto_map, custom_pipelines, and unsafe attention configuration content.
The worker never invokes Transformers Trainer APIs.
exceptions.exitCriteria: Upgrade to a tested qwen-tts release compatible with a non-vulnerable Transformers version, then remove the pip-audit ignore and this exception.
exceptions.approval: Accepted for the Speak 0.5.2 release with weekly review and expiry enforcement.

renewalHistory.reason: Renewed after confirming the technical blocker and documented compensating controls are unchanged.

exceptions.owner: Speak repository security and release owner
exceptions.technicalBlocker: qwen-tts 0.1.1 exactly pins Transformers 4.57.3, while the patched 5.3+ line is currently incompatible with Qwen audio generation.

compensatingControls: HF_HUB_OFFLINE and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE are set before Transformers imports.
Model validation rejects _attn_implementation_internal, auto_map, custom_pipelines, and trust_remote_code content.
Remote repositories and custom kernels are not accepted by the Qwen worker.
exceptions.exitCriteria: Upgrade to a tested qwen-tts release compatible with Transformers 5.3 or later and remove this exception.
exceptions.approval: Accepted for the Speak 0.5.2 release with offline-only model loading and expiry enforcement.

exceptions.owner: Speak repository security and release owner
exceptions.technicalBlocker: The official CUDA 12.6 index provides Torch 2.13 but no matching TorchAudio 2.13 build. Qwen imports torchaudio.compliance.kaldi, and TorchAudio documents that its binaries must match the corresponding Torch release.
exceptions.exploitabilityAssessment: The advisory requires torch.jit.script on attacker-controlled code. Speak's Qwen path does not use torch.jit.script and accepts only validated local model data.
compensatingControls: The Qwen worker does not call torch.jit.script.
Only validated local Qwen model trees are accepted.
The Dependabot alert remains open and is reviewed weekly rather than dismissed.
exceptions.exitCriteria: Move Qwen to a tested, officially matched Torch and TorchAudio pair at or above the patched Torch version, then close the open alert and remove this exception.
exceptions.approval: Accepted for the Speak 0.5.2 release while the alert remains visible and matching official binaries are unavailable.

renewalHistory.reason: Renewed after confirming the technical blocker and documented compensating controls are unchanged.

exceptions.owner: Speak repository security and release owner
exceptions.technicalBlocker: Qwen currently requires Torch 2.12.1, whose official wheel metadata requires setuptools<82. The advisory is fixed in setuptools 83.0.0, so the patched version makes the official Qwen dependency graph unsatisfiable.
exceptions.exploitabilityAssessment: The issue affects Unicode normalization while building source distributions on macOS APFS or HFS+. Speak 0.5.2 is a Windows application, uses prebuilt wheels, and does not build or publish source distributions at runtime.
compensatingControls: Speak supports Windows and does not execute Qwen packaging workflows on macOS.
The runtime installs pinned prebuilt wheels and never builds source distributions from untrusted file trees.
The exception is expiry-enforced and removed when the Qwen Torch stack permits setuptools 83 or later.
exceptions.exitCriteria: Move Qwen to a tested Torch release that permits setuptools 83.0.0 or later, then remove the audit ignore and this exception.
exceptions.approval: Accepted for the Windows-only Speak 0.5.2 release because the affected source-distribution path is not used.

renewalHistory.reason: Renewed after confirming the technical blocker and documented compensating controls are unchanged.

exceptions.owner: Speak repository security and release owner
exceptions.technicalBlocker: qwen-tts 0.1.1 pins accelerate==1.12.0. The upstream advisory has no patched release yet.
exceptions.exploitabilityAssessment: The advisory concerns path traversal and denial of service through sharded checkpoint weight_map entries. Speak loads only validated local Qwen model directories, rejects symlinks and executable content, and does not fetch sharded checkpoints from remote repositories.
compensatingControls: Only validated local Qwen model directories are accepted.
Remote model downloads and repository IDs are rejected; offline mode is enforced.
Model validation rejects symlinks, executable files, pickle-based weights, and custom code.
exceptions.exitCriteria: Move Qwen to a tested accelerate release containing the upstream fix, then remove the pip-audit ignore and this exception.
exceptions.approval: Accepted for Speak 0.5.3 while qwen-tts requires the affected accelerate release and no patched version is available.

exceptions.owner: Speak repository security and release owner
exceptions.technicalBlocker: qwen-tts 0.1.1 pins transformers==4.57.3. PYSEC-2026-3929 is fixed in 5.10.0, which is not API-compatible with the current Qwen runtime; PYSEC-2026-4174 has no fixed release.
exceptions.exploitabilityAssessment: PYSEC-2026-3929 requires attacker-controlled chat-template names during save_pretrained, which Speak does not call. PYSEC-2026-4174 concerns downloading custom generation code before trust consent; Speak forces offline local-only loading and rejects custom code.
compensatingControls: HF_HUB_OFFLINE and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE are set before Transformers imports.
Speak does not call save_pretrained or load remote chat templates.
Model validation rejects auto_map, custom_pipelines, trust_remote_code, executables, symlinks, and pickle weights.
exceptions.exitCriteria: Upgrade to a tested qwen-tts release compatible with Transformers 5.10.0 or later, then remove this exception.
exceptions.approval: Accepted for Speak 0.5.3 because qwen-tts pins Transformers 4.57.3 and the patched 5.10 line is not release-safe for Qwen audio generation.

exceptions.technicalBlocker: Qwen requires Torch 2.12.1, whose official wheel metadata requires setuptools<82. The advisory is fixed in setuptools 84.1.0, so the patched version makes the official Qwen dependency graph unsatisfiable.

compensatingControls: Speak installs pinned prebuilt wheels and never builds source distributions from untrusted trees.
The Qwen runtime runs offline with validated local model data only.
The exception is expiry-enforced and removed when the Qwen Torch stack permits setuptools 84.1.0 or later.
exceptions.exitCriteria: Move Qwen to a tested Torch release that permits setuptools 84.1.0 or later, then remove the ignore and this exception.

exceptions.owner: Speak repository security and release owner
exceptions.technicalBlocker: qwen-tts 0.1.1 pulls gradio 6.17.3, which requires pillow<13.0. Upgrading to gradio 6.32.0 would allow Pillow 13, but it requires huggingface-hub>=1.16.0 while transformers 4.57.3 requires huggingface-hub<1.0. The Qwen stack therefore cannot adopt the patched Pillow release.
exceptions.exploitabilityAssessment: The advisories affect image decoding and parsing in Pillow. Speak's Qwen worker is a loopback-only FastAPI service that accepts audio and text, does not import or expose the bundled Gradio demo, and does not process untrusted images.
compensatingControls: The Qwen worker binds to 127.0.0.1 and rejects non-loopback Host headers.
Speak does not import or expose the qwen-tts Gradio demo; its worker uses FastAPI audio and text endpoints only.
Only validated local model directories and bounded audio/text inputs are accepted.
exceptions.exitCriteria: Upgrade the Qwen, Gradio, and Transformers stack to a compatible combination that permits Pillow 13.0.0 or later, then remove the pip-audit ignores and this exception.
exceptions.approval: Accepted for Speak 0.5.3 because Gradio/Transformers pins block the patched Pillow release and the Qwen worker is local-only and does not process untrusted images.
